observable: minimum flexible (G4S)-type linker length for intramolecular VH-VL pairing (a monomeric scFv); shorter linkers force diabodies
note: VH C-terminus to VL N-terminus gap ~32-35 A (direct scFv measurement 32 A in structure 4H11). Model lower bound ceil(35/3.5)=10 res sits just below it as expected since real coils are not fully extended.

note: Arai compared helical vs flexible linkers; the flexible coil samples a broad end-to-end distribution so adding residues does not cleanly set domain separation. GS length-independence is also the general finding in the flexible-linker literature.

observable: which linker holds the two fluorophore domains at a more fixed separation
note: Tests the library premise helix=rigid / coil=flexible on Arai's real construct: the helical linker gives a length-tunable fixed separation while GS collapses so the rigid one is the helix.
